title: Refinement and base change for fixed normalized proper/open comparisons
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring. Use bounded-below derived etale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], exact open extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], proper maps [def-weil-proper-morphism] and open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. For every commutative proper/open square fix ordinary natural isomorphisms delta:i_!r_*≅p_*k_! and derived natural isomorphisms gamma:i_!Rr_*≅Rp_*k_!. Assume that for each square k:A→B, i:C→D, r:A→C, p:B→D with k p=r i, delta_F followed by p_*(k_!F→k_*F) and the compositor k_*p_*→(k p)_* equals i_!r_*F→i_*r_*F followed by the compositor r_*i_*→(k p)_*. Assume also that gamma.hom is exactly rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange(delta.hom). Then (1) on a proper refinement fixing the open, gamma, after the canonical identity-direct-image identification, equals properOpenComparison [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison]; and (2) for every Cartesian base change the gamma square commutes with the canonical extension-by-zero base-change isomorphisms [cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change] and the canonical derived exchange maps [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients], with the exact equation specified in the Lean record. Only equalities of these already supplied maps are asserted; no existence or invertibility claim is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the derived unit equation [lem-cbc-proper-open-derived-unit-normalization] to the given δ on the refinement triangle. The proved unit characterization [lem-weil-pbc-proper-open-identification-unit] identifies its last two factors with properOpenIdentification.hom followed by η₁. The derived open unit η₁ is invertible by fully faithful open extension. Cancel η₁ and the identification to show that the open-adjoint transpose of the canonical derived δ is properOpenIdentification.inv. Injectivity of the open adjunction homEquiv identifies the original map with properOpenComparison. Finally hγ replaces γ by the canonical lift.

For ordinary sheaves compose both paths of the cube with p₁* of the support inclusion k₁!→k₁* and the pushforward compositor. properSupportSheafComposition realizes the inclusion as injective on sections, hence monic. Use the ordinary open-base-change/inclusion equation, naturality, vertical mate pasting, and the assumed δ normalization to identify both paths with the same map in the common ordinary direct image. Cancel the monic inclusion. No Noetherian hypotheses are used.

Apply rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_cube to the proved ordinary cube. The exact transverse isomorphisms are the inverses of the ordinary open-base-change maps. The definition of extensionZeroBaseChangeDerivedPlusIso and compatibility of exact derived natural isomorphisms with inversion identify these transverse derived maps. The remaining two faces are definitionally derivedBaseChangeMapPlus. Replace the canonical lifted δ faces by γ using hγ and reassociate, giving the complete base-change conjunct.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7F; ordinary support cube proved directly; refinement uses the proved identification-unit theorem and one strictly algebraic unit normalization step
